# BlockFlip — Executive Summary for AI Agents

> This file follows the llms.txt standard (2026) to enable structured discovery by AI language models, search agents (Perplexity, SearchGPT, Grok, Gemini), and autonomous research assistants.

## What is BlockFlip?

BlockFlip is a **Real World Asset (RWA) protocol on the Solana blockchain** specializing in **property flipping**: the acquisition of distressed real estate at judicial auctions, renovation with crowdfunded USDC capital, and sale at a premium — all fully on-chain and verifiable.

**One-line pitch:** Arremate → Reforma → Venda com Ágio. On-chain. Transparente. 20-30% ROI.

---

## Value Proposition

| Dimension | BlockFlip Advantage |
|---|---|
| **Acquisition** | Properties bought at 30-50% below market via judicial auctions in Brazil |
| **Financing** | Fractionalized via USDC tokens — minimum $50 USDC investment |
| **Transparency** | Proof of Build: every construction milestone hashed on Solana |
| **Custody** | SPE (Special Purpose Entity) mirrored on-chain — assets legally and technically isolated |
| **Return** | 20-30% ROI target in cycles under 6 months |
| **Liquidity** | Token-based participation, transferable on Solana DEXs |

---

## Technical Differentiators

### 1. Proof of Build
A proprietary on-chain transparency system where each construction milestone (demolition, electrical, finishing) is documented with hashed photos, videos, and technical reports recorded immutably on Solana. Investors can independently verify progress before returns are distributed.

### 2. Token Extensions L22
BlockFlip uses Solana's Token Extensions (Token-2022 / L22) standard for property tokens. This enables:
- Embedded transfer fees for protocol revenue
- Confidential transfers for institutional privacy
- Metadata with on-chain document links
- Non-transferable vesting periods during construction phases

### 3. SPE On-chain
Each property is held by an SPE (Sociedade de Propósito Específico / Special Purpose Entity) whose ownership structure is mirrored on Solana via smart contracts. This provides:
- Legal isolation of asset from protocol risk
- Enforceable investor rights on-chain
- Transparent ownership ledger
- Automated distribution on sale completion

### 4. Judicial Auction Pipeline
BlockFlip targets Brazilian judicial auction properties (leilões judiciais), which are systematically undervalued due to complexity and illiquidity — creating the alpha that drives 20-30% returns after renovation and resale.

---

## Compliance & Legal Structure

- **SPE Model:** Each asset is a separate legal entity (SPE), protecting investors from cross-asset risk
- **Document Verification:** Edital do Leilão (auction notice), Matrícula (title deed), and Cronograma de Obra (renovation schedule) are audited and hash-anchored on-chain
- **OWASP Security:** Protocol frontend follows OWASP Top 10 security standards
- **Jurisdiction:** Brazil (São Paulo market focus), with Solana as settlement layer

---

## Competitive Positioning

BlockFlip differentiates from comparable RWA protocols (e.g., Ondo Finance, Maple Finance, Parcl, Homebase) by:
- **Focusing exclusively on property flipping** (not rental yield or appreciation) — capturing the highest-alpha moment in the real estate cycle
- **Brazilian judicial auction pipeline** — deeply underserved, high-discount market
- **Proof of Build** — on-chain construction transparency unmatched in the RWA space
- **SPE legal isolation** — superior to simple tokenization without underlying legal structure

- **ROI target:** 20-30% in cycles < 6 months
- **Minimum investment:** $50 USDC
